result.description: Web data platform: proxies, Web Unlocker, SERP API, scraping browser, pre-built scrapers and datasets for public web data collection.
result.auth_detail: API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on REST API. Proxy access uses native username/password (brd-customer-ID-zone-NAME:password). Key generated in account settings by admin; default key created at signup.
result.access_detail: Anyone can sign up; default API key auto-created. MCP free tier 5,000 requests/month, no credit card. Beyond free, pay-as-you-go billing.
result.api_notes: REST API covers Web Unlocker (POST api.brightdata.com/request), SERP, Scrapers (1,200+ pre-built), Scraping Browser, Functions (Scraper Studio), Marketplace datasets; proxy networks via proxy protocol. Also CLI, Python and JS SDKs.

evidence.quote: An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API.
We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically.
No credit card or commitment required to start.
5,000 free requests per month, renewing on the 1st of each month.
The Bright Data MCP server gives AI agents real-time access to public web data.
A powerful Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides an all-in-one solution for public web access.
If you don't see the 'API key' section, switch to an admin account.
